If you received the permission , your partner should be in the system. She will need an ETA-IL  to board the flight. If you are not married , you‘ll need another appointment for an interview and after that she should receive B1. 
You can find all information on our website 

https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/
